components.name: Primary Button (App)
components.description: Default action button in the desktop app. Uses content-adaptive colors.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.4; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); background: oklch(98.5% 0 0deg); color: oklch(20.5% 0 0deg); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(70.8% 0 0deg); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button (Landing)
components.description: Download CTA on the landing page. Deep indigo with hover lift.
components.html: Download
components.css: .ds-btn-landing-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.3; border: none; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); background: oklch(20.5% 0.042 265.755deg); color: oklch(98.5% 0 0deg); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px oklch(20.5% 0.042 265.755deg / 0.2); } .ds-btn-landing-primary:hover { transform: scale(1.02); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px oklch(20.5% 0.042 265.755deg / 0.3); } .ds-btn-landing-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(20.5% 0.042 265.755deg); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Slider (App)
components.description: Seek position and volume slider used in the player bar.
components.css: .ds-slider { position: relative; display: flex; width: 100%; height: 24px; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; touch-action: none; user-select: none; } .ds-slider-track { position: relative; height: 6px; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(100% 0 0deg / 0.2); } .ds-slider-range { position: absolute; height: 100%; background: oklch(98.5% 0 0deg); border-radius: 9999px; } .ds-slider-thumb { position: absolute; top: 50%; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(98.5% 0 0deg); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); transition: box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-slider-thumb:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(43.9% 0 0deg); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Feature Card (Landing)
components.description: Gallery-style feature card with icon and description. Lifts on hover.
components.html:
Multi-Format Playback

MP3, FLAC, OGG, M4A, AAC, WAV, AIFF — no conversion needed.
components.css: .ds-feature-card { display: flex; gap: 14px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid oklch(92.2% 0.004 286.375deg / 0.6); background: oklch(100% 0 0deg); transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); cursor: default; } .ds-feature-card:hover { border-color: oklch(20.5% 0.042 265.755deg / 0.3); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); } .ds-feature-icon { flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 8px; background: oklch(20.5% 0.042 265.755deg / 0.08); color: oklch(20.5% 0.042 265.755deg); } .ds-feature-title { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; color: oklch(14.5% 0 0deg); margin: 0 0 2px 0; } .ds-feature-desc { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; color: oklch(55.6% 0.013 286.375deg); margin: 0; }

narrative.overview: VibeMusic has two faces, one design language. The app is The Dark Room — a receding dark chrome where the album art provides the color. The landing is The Gallery — a white canvas where the indigo brand color commands attention. Both share Instrument Sans typography, restrained color strategies, and a precision-over-ornament ethos.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic app shell gives album art full color authority
Tonal layering (not shadows) for depth in the app
Gentle shadow-on-hover for cards on the landing
Single typeface for the app; complementary display+body pair for the landing

rules.name: The One Chroma Rule
rules.body: The interface chrome carries zero chroma at rest. Color enters only through dynamic content (album art, background gradient) or explicit user choice.

rules.name: The Single Face Rule
rules.body: One family, four weight/scale combinations. Hierarchy comes from scale and weight, not from font switching.

rules.name: The Gallery Wall Rule
rules.body: The landing background is always pure white. No tints, no gradients, no patterns on the body canvas.

rules.name: The One-Heading Rule
rules.body: The hero heading is the only Display-sized text on the landing page. No section headers compete at display scale.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: App surfaces are flat at rest. Depth is conveyed by lightness, not by shadow. Landing cards are the only exception, and only on hover.

dos: Do let album art and the dynamic background gradient be the primary color source on screen.
Do use tonal layering (lighter backgrounds) to show hierarchy — never box-shadow in the app.
Do keep the sidebar receded (muted icons, no labels at rest).
Do use pure white as the landing canvas.
Do show platform badges and open-source license in the landing footer.
Do ensure body text hits ≥4.5:1 against the background at all times.
donts: Don't use gradient text, glassmorphism-as-default, or numbered section markers.
Don't use side-stripe borders (colored border-left >1px on cards or list items).
Don't add box-shadow to any app surface — depth is conveyed by lightness.
Don't use two similar typefaces. App uses one family; landing uses Instrument Sans + Inter as a deliberate contrast pair.
Don't gate content visibility on class-triggered animations.
Don't use the AI-template landing reflexes: no glass cards, no numbered section eyebrows, no tiny uppercase tracked section headers.
